fields.hint: Short summary of who this community is for.

fields.name: heroImage
fields.label: Hero image
fields.hint: Full-bleed header background. Blank falls back to the centered header.

fields.name: tagline
fields.label: Tagline
fields.hint: Subtitle beneath the "HARVARD IN TECH <NAME>" title.

fields.name: showGallery
fields.label: Show event gallery
fields.hint: Blank shows the gallery; switch off to hide it on this community.

fields.name: contactEmail
fields.label: Contact email
fields.hint: Blank falls back to the global contact email in Settings.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Optional pin. Blank sorts the community alphabetically by name.

fields.name: tier
fields.label: Partnership level
fields.hint: The level id from the Sponsorship page settings (presenting, chapter, event, community). Blank groups the sponsor under Other partners.

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.hint: Blank shows the sponsor's name as text instead.

fields.name: placeholder
fields.label: Example entry
fields.hint: Switch ON for an illustrative entry. The wall then shows an 'examples, not actual sponsors' notice. Leave OFF for a real sponsor.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Optional pin. Blank sorts the sponsor alphabetically within its level.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.hint: How the donor should be credited. Still required for an anonymous gift — the site hides it, our records keep it.

fields.name: tier
fields.label: Giving level
fields.hint: The level id from the Momentum Fund page settings (leadership, sustaining, supporting). Blank or unrecognized groups the donor under Other supporters rather than hiding them.

fields.name: founding
fields.label: Founding donor
fields.hint: Switch ON to show the Founding Donor badge. It is a badge, not a level — a founding donor keeps whatever giving level they gave at.

fields.name: anonymous
fields.label: List anonymously
fields.hint: Switch ON when the donor asked not to be named. The wall shows 'Anonymous donor' and drops their website link; this entry still keeps the name for our records.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Note
fields.hint: One short line shown on the donor's card. Their words, or ours about them.

fields.name: school
fields.label: School
fields.hint: Which Harvard school they came through. Shown on their node in the network, and what 'find your school' searches on — so pick from the list rather than inventing a spelling the search will miss. Hidden when the gift is listed anonymously.
options: Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences
Harvard Graduate School of Arts and Sciences

fields.name: gradYear
fields.label: Class year
fields.hint: The year they graduated, shown beside the school on their node. Hidden when the gift is listed anonymously.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.hint: City or region, as they would say it — 'London, United Kingdom', 'San Francisco, CA'. Used by the network's location search. Hidden when the gift is listed anonymously.

fields.name: why
fields.label: Why I gave
fields.hint: The supporter's OWN words, used to pre-fill the message when they share their badge. Different from Note above, which is the line we write for the wall — leave this blank unless they told us themselves, and the share message simply leaves the line out. Hidden when the gift is listed anonymously.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Website
fields.hint: LinkedIn or a personal site. Ignored when the gift is listed anonymously.

fields.name: photo
fields.label: Photo
fields.hint: Blank shows the donor's initials instead.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Optional pin. Blank sorts the donor alphabetically within their giving level.

fields.name: startDate
fields.label: Start date
fields.hint: When the project begins. Shown on the card and project page; does not hide the project.

fields.name: endDate
fields.label: End date
fields.hint: When the project wraps up. Use the Active toggle to take a finished project off the page.

fields.name: affiliation
fields.label: Affiliation
fields.hint: Their connection to Harvard, shown above the role — for example "Harvard Extension School Alumni · Class of 2023". Blank shows the role on its own.

fields.name: photo
fields.label: Photo
fields.hint: A portrait of the person quoted, shown as a small round photo beside their name. Blank shows the name and role without a picture.

fields.name: eventPhoto
fields.label: Event photo
fields.hint: A photo from the event this quote came out of, shown as a large picture beside the quote. Different from the Photo above, which is the person. Blank runs the quote across the full width.

fields.name: eventCaption
fields.label: Event photo caption
fields.hint: The line printed under the event photo, naming the event and the city. Only shows when there is an event photo.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Section type
fields.hint: Which section this is. "narrative" uses the title, layout, image, and body below; "mission" and "testimonials" use the title and the body (testimonials shows the body as an intro above the quotes); "goal-meter" uses the title, the Goal meter widget ID, and the link boxes — the rest are bands whose content is edited in their own collection. Every type shows the Kicker below.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Heading
fields.hint: The heading shown above this section on the page, and the name this section goes by in this list. Fill it in to tell two sections of the same type apart — two "pillars" bands, for example. Blank keeps the standard heading for the section type.

fields.name: kicker
fields.label: Kicker
fields.hint: The small uppercase line above the heading — for example "What your gift powers". Works on every section type. Blank shows the heading on its own.

fields.name: group
fields.label: Card group
fields.hint: Which cards this band shows. Type the same word here and in the Group box on each card that belongs to it. Blank shows the cards that have no group, which is how the page reads today — so leave it alone unless you are splitting a band in two.

fields.name: layout
fields.label: Layout
fields.hint: Narrative sections only. Where the photo sits. Choose "columns" to set the text in two newspaper-style columns with no photo at all. Leave as none to run the text full width.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.hint: Shown beside the text on image-left / image-right sections. Blank shows the text full width.

fields.name: widgetId
fields.label: Goal meter widget ID
fields.hint: Goal meter sections only. The widget ID from Givebutter (Dashboard → your campaign → Share → Embed): the id= value in the code they give you. Blank means the section shows nothing at all. Best placed just above the closing ask, so progress and the Give button read as one moment.

fields.name: linkLabel
fields.label: Goal meter link text
fields.hint: Goal meter sections only. The wording of the link beside the heading — for example "View the campaign". Needs the link address below to show at all.

fields.name: linkUrl
fields.label: Goal meter link address
fields.hint: Where the link beside the goal meter heading goes — usually your Givebutter campaign page. Needs the link text above to show at all.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers appear higher on the page. To reorder, use the ↑ and ↓ arrows on the sections list — this box is for setting an exact position. Blank puts the section last.

fields.name: comingSoon
fields.label: Show as coming soon
fields.hint: Switch ON to replace this section with a short "coming soon" placeholder. Switch the Draft toggle on instead to remove the section and its menu link entirely. Both off means the section shows normally.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Section type
fields.hint: Which band of the homepage this is.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Heading
fields.hint: Only used by the "coming soon" placeholder, as the heading it announces. Blank falls back to the section's usual name.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers appear higher on the page. To reorder, use the ↑ and ↓ arrows on the sections list — this box is for setting an exact position. Blank puts it last.

fields.name: comingSoon
fields.label: Show as coming soon
fields.hint: Switch ON to replace this section with a short "coming soon" placeholder. Switch the Draft toggle on instead to remove the section and its menu link entirely. Both off means the section shows normally.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: The large headline on the slide.

fields.name: kicker
fields.label: Kicker
fields.hint: The small line above the headline.

fields.name: lede
fields.label: Lede
fields.hint: The paragraph beneath the headline.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Background image
fields.hint: The full-bleed photo behind the slide. Blank leaves the crimson backdrop.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers come first in the rotation. Blank puts the slide last.

fields.name: ctas
fields.label: Buttons
fields.hint: Up to two buttons. Variant "solid" is the filled button, "out" is the outlined one; anything else renders solid.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Figure
fields.hint: The big number, e.g. 8,000+ or Est. 2013.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.hint: The small caption under the figure.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers appear further left. Blank puts the figure last.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Figure
fields.hint: The big number on the card, e.g. 600+.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.hint: What the figure counts.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.hint: One or two sentences beneath the figure.

fields.name: group
fields.label: Group
fields.hint: Which band shows this card. Type the same word here and in the Card group box on the section that should show it. Blank means the card belongs to the ungrouped band, which is where every card sits today.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers appear first. Blank puts the card last.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.hint: What this gift powers.

fields.name: linkLabel
fields.label: Link label
fields.hint: Optional link at the bottom of the card. Leave both link fields blank for a plain card.

fields.name: group
fields.label: Group
fields.hint: Which band shows this card. Type the same word here and in the Card group box on the section that should show it. Blank means the card belongs to the ungrouped band, which is where every card sits today.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers appear first. Blank puts the card last.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Page
fields.hint: Which page these settings belong to.

fields.name: donateUrl
fields.label: Donation platform URL
fields.hint: Where every Give button points. Blank keeps them on the giving-inquiry email, which is what they do today. Paste a real platform URL here to switch them all over at once.

fields.name: heroHeadlineNamed
fields.label: Hero headline (personalised)
fields.hint: Shown to someone arriving from the campaign email. Write {name} where their first name should go.

fields.name: heroHeadlineGeneric
fields.label: Hero headline
fields.hint: Shown to everyone else, and to anyone whose link carries no name. Keep the two headlines saying the same thing.

fields.name: heroKicker
fields.label: Hero kicker
fields.hint: The small uppercase line above the hero headline, naming the campaign. Blank shows the headline on its own.

fields.name: heroSubhead
fields.label: Hero text
fields.hint: The line under the headline.

fields.name: heroImage
fields.label: Hero image
fields.hint: Full-bleed photo behind the headline.

fields.name: heroVideo
fields.label: Hero video
fields.hint: Optional moving backdrop. Paste a path like /videos/momentum.mp4 for a video file committed under public/videos/. It plays silently on a loop with no controls, the hero image above is used as its first frame and as the fallback if it cannot play, and clearing this box brings the photo back. Keep it to a few megabytes — every visitor downloads it.

fields.name: ctaKicker
fields.label: Closing kicker
fields.hint: The small uppercase line above the closing heading.

fields.name: ctaTitle
fields.label: Closing heading
fields.hint: The heading of the final ask at the bottom of the page.

fields.name: ctaBody
fields.label: Closing text
fields.hint: The paragraph under it. Leave a blank line between paragraphs to write more than one.

fields.name: ctaImage
fields.label: Closing image
fields.hint: The photo beside the closing ask. Blank runs the closing text across the full width instead.

fields.name: ctaTagline
fields.label: Closing tagline
fields.hint: A short uppercase sign-off under the give button — for example "One community. Shared momentum." Blank shows nothing.

fields.name: ctaLabel
fields.label: Give button label
fields.hint: Used on EVERY giving button on the page — hero, donor wall, and the closing ask.

fields.name: campaignName
fields.label: Campaign name
fields.hint: The campaign's name. Shown in the browser tab, in the closing band, and in the message supporters share.

fields.name: stats
fields.label: Headline figures
fields.hint: The row of big numbers near the top of the page. These belong to this page only — the homepage has its own set under Homepage figures.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Figure
fields.hint: The number itself, written how you want it to read — for example 8,000+.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Caption
fields.hint: What the number counts, in a few words.

fields.name: donorsEmptyMessage
fields.label: Donor wall — before the first gift
fields.hint: What the recognition wall says while it is still empty. This is what a prospective first donor reads, so it is worth getting right.

fields.name: donorTiers
fields.label: Donor wall tiers
fields.hint: The groups the donor wall sorts names into, top to bottom.

fields.name: id
fields.label: Tier ID
fields.hint: CAREFUL: this is the code each donor's Tier field points at, not a label anyone sees. Changing it drops every donor already in this tier off the wall until each one is re-pointed. Rename the Tier name below instead — that is the part visitors read.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Tier name
fields.hint: The heading shown above this group on the wall. Safe to reword at any time.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Tier description
fields.hint: The line under the tier heading. Blank shows the heading on its own.

fields.name: networkTitle
fields.label: Momentum Network heading
fields.hint: The heading above the network visualization.

fields.name: networkTagline
fields.label: Momentum Network tagline
fields.hint: The line under that heading, explaining what the lights represent.

fields.name: networkSearchTitle
fields.label: Momentum Network search heading
fields.hint: The label over the box where a supporter finds themselves in the network.

fields.name: shareMessage
fields.label: Supporter share message
fields.hint: The message a supporter posts from their badge. Keep [SUPPORTER MESSAGE] and [DONATION LINK] exactly as written — they are placeholders the badge swaps for the supporter's own words and the giving link. Delete either one and that part goes missing from what they share.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Entry name
fields.hint: Names this entry in the admin list. Not shown on the site.

fields.name: kicker
fields.label: Kicker
fields.hint: The small label above the headline.

fields.name: heroImage
fields.label: Hero image
fields.hint: Full-bleed photo behind the headline.

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: The big line at the top of the page. Blank falls back to the wording the site ships with.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.hint: The paragraph under the headline.

fields.name: benefitsTitle
fields.label: Benefits heading
fields.hint: Heading above the "Why Volunteer" blocks.

fields.name: projectsTitle
fields.label: Projects heading
fields.hint: Heading above the open-projects grid.

fields.name: projectsIntro
fields.label: Projects intro
fields.hint: The line under that heading.

fields.name: projectsEmptyMessage
fields.label: No open projects message
fields.hint: Shown INSTEAD of the grid when no volunteer projects are published. This is what the page shows today, so it is worth reading as real copy rather than a fallback.

fields.name: ctaLabel
fields.label: Sign-up button label
fields.hint: Used on this page AND on every individual project page.

fields.name: ctaUrl
fields.label: Sign-up link
fields.hint: Where the sign-up button goes.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Entry name
fields.hint: Names this entry in the admin list. Not shown on the site.

fields.name: kicker
fields.label: Kicker
fields.hint: The small label above the headline.

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: The big line at the top of the page.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.hint: The paragraph under the headline.

fields.name: heroImage
fields.label: Hero image
fields.hint: Full-bleed photo behind the headline.

fields.name: levelsTitle
fields.label: Partnership levels heading
fields.hint: Heading above the levels. The levels themselves are edited in Sponsorship levels.

fields.name: levelsIntro
fields.label: Partnership levels intro
fields.hint: The line under that heading.

fields.name: wallTitle
fields.label: Partner wall heading
fields.hint: Heading above the logos.

fields.name: wallEmptyMessage
fields.label: No partners message
fields.hint: Shown INSTEAD of the wall when no sponsors are published — which is the state today.

fields.name: inquiryTitle
fields.label: Enquiry heading
fields.hint: Heading of the "start a conversation" section.

fields.name: inquiryBody
fields.label: Enquiry text
fields.hint: The paragraph under it.

fields.name: inquiryFormUrl
fields.label: Enquiry form URL
fields.hint: A Google Form or Typeform URL. Leave BLANK to show the placeholder instead of an embedded form — clearing this box is how you take a form back down.

fields.name: disclaimer
fields.label: Legal line
fields.hint: The Harvard Alumni Association requires a Shared Interest Group to state that contributions go to the group and not to the University. Change the wording, but do not remove it.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.hint: How the level is shown on the page, e.g. "Event Partner". Safe to rename at any time — sponsors are filed under the entry itself, not under this text.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Summary
fields.hint: One line saying what this level underwrites.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers appear higher up. The wall reads top-down from the biggest commitment.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Entry name
fields.hint: Names this entry in the admin list. Not shown on the site.

fields.name: googleAnalyticsId
fields.label: Google Analytics ID
fields.hint: A GA4 measurement ID, e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX. Leave blank and the site ships no analytics at all.

fields.name: givebutterAccountId
fields.label: Givebutter account ID
fields.hint: The acct= value from the embed code Givebutter gives you (Dashboard → Integrations → Embeds). Leave blank and the site loads no Givebutter code at all. Required before a Goal meter section can show a meter.

fields.name: customHeadHtml
fields.label: Custom <head> HTML
fields.hint: Verification tags and pixels. This runs on EVERY page of the site, so only paste markup you trust and got from a service you recognise.

fields.name: customBodyHtml
fields.label: Custom end-of-page HTML
fields.hint: Same warning as above. Use this for snippets a provider tells you to put at the end of the page rather than in the head.

events.name: chapter
events.label: Chapter or community
events.hint: The slug of the chapter or community this event belongs to (the filename without .md). Blank means it belongs to neither and shows only on the events page.

seo.name: metaTitle
seo.label: SEO title
seo.hint: The <title> and share-card title. Falls back to the entry title.

seo.name: metaDescription
seo.label: Meta description
seo.hint: The search + social description. Falls back to the summary, then the site default.

seo.name: ogImage
seo.label: Share image
seo.hint: The social share card image. Falls back to the site default.
